title: Feedback-Controlled Self-Trapping of Solitons
abstract: Chip-scale microresonator-based frequency combs, commonly referred to as microcombs, are promising sources for field-deployable metrology applications. However, intrinsic microresonator noise can make it difficult to generate microcombs with sufficiently low noise for applications. A widely used approach to overcome this limitation is to trap the DKS in the microresonator by phase-modulating the pump laser, although integrating a low-noise modulation reference in a fully on-chip platform remains challenging. Here, we propose an optoelectronic self-trapping scheme in which the impact of intrinsic microresonator noise on microcomb repetition-rate jitter is suppressed through feedback-controlled phase modulation of the driving laser so that the intrinsic noise of the laser sets the ultimate performance limit. This modification eliminates the need for an external low-phase-noise RF source, thereby enabling chip integration. We develop both analytical and numerical models for the proposed system and benchmark its performance against conventional externally referenced bulk implementations, showing that the proposed approach achieves comparable microcomb noise suppression while maintaining chip-scale compatibility.

summaries.en: A feedback-controlled optoelectronic self-trapping scheme phase-modulates the pump laser to suppress microresonator-noise-induced microcomb repetition-rate jitter, eliminating the need for an external low-phase-noise RF reference while remaining chip-compatible.

title: Optical parametric amplification of spatiotemporal optical vortices
abstract: Spatiotemporal optical vortices (STOVs) are structured light featuring a phase singularity in the spatiotemporal domain, exhibiting unique topology that couples spatial and temporal dimensions. To date, amplification of STOVs remains unexplored, and their wavelength tunability is limited by available light sources. In this work, we present the theoretical analysis and experimental demonstration of optical parametric amplification (OPA) of STOVs. The pulse energy of the STOV signal is enhanced by a factor of 60, while its spatiotemporal structure is robustly preserved. The generated idler inherits the phase-conjugated STOV topology with the opposite topological charge, governed by simultaneous conservation of energy, linear momentum, and spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum. The intrinsic wavelength-conversion capability of OPA further provides a route towards spectrally tunable STOV generation, spanning from visible to near-infrared wavelength regimes. This work paves the way toward further development of multi-stage amplification architectures, facilitating applications of wavelength-tunable spatiotemporally structured light at ultrahigh intensities.

summaries.en: This work theoretically and experimentally demonstrates optical parametric amplification of spatiotemporal optical vortices, achieving a 60-fold pulse energy enhancement with robust preservation of the spatiotemporal structure and generating a phase-conjugated idler with opposite topological charge via conservation of spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum.
summaries.zh: 该工作从理论和实验上实现了时空光学涡旋的光参量放大，在稳健保持时空结构的同时将脉冲能量提升了60倍，并通过时空轨道角动量守恒产生了具有相反拓扑荷的相位共轭闲频光。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、時空間光学渦の光パラメトリック増幅を理論と実験の両面で実証し、時空間構造を堅牢に保持しつつパルスエネルギーを60倍に増強するとともに、時空間軌道角運動量の保存に従って反対のトポロジカル電荷を持つ位相共役なアイドラー光を生成した。

title: Photoinduced Modulation of Rectification and Charge Transport in Diarylethene-Viologen Molecular Junction
abstract: Large-area molecular junctions combining photochromic and redox-active functionalities provide an attractive platform for controlling charge transport by light. In this work, we study Au/DAEVIO/Ti/Au molecular junctions incorporated with electro-grafted layers of diarylethene-viologen with thicknesses of 12-16 nm. In the initial OFF state, the junctions exhibit low current densities and strong rectification, with a rectification ratio of 300 at 1V. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal a thermally assisted contribution at higher temperatures and a much weaker temperature dependence below 160-180K, consistent with multistep charge transport through molecular and/or interfacial states rather than direct coherent tunneling across the entire molecular layer. Under continuous in situ 385 nm irradiation, the electrical response is strongly and asymmetrically modified. The current density at +1V increases by a factor of 200, while the negative-bias current is only weakly modified, reducing the rectification ratio from 300 to 2. Illumination also produces a nonzero short-circuit current density of + 0.006mA cm-2 and an open-circuit voltage of -0.45V. These results indicate that irradiation simultaneously modifies molecular charge transport and generates a measurable photoelectric response. This behavior is consistent with light-induced changes in electronic coupling associated with DAE photocyclization, combined with photoinduced charge generation and field-dependent charge separation involving the redox-active viologen units and asymmetric electrode interfaces.

summaries.en: Photoirradiation of Au/diarylethene-viologen/Ti/Au molecular junctions with 12-16 nm electro-grafted layers decreases the rectification ratio from 300 to 2 at 1V by increasing the forward current density 200-fold and only weakly affecting the reverse bias, while also generating a short-circuit current density of +0.
summaries.zh: 对具有12-16 nm电接枝层的Au/二芳基乙烯-紫精/Ti/Au分子结进行光照，使1V下的整流比从300降至2，这是通过将正向电流密度提高200倍且仅微弱改变反向偏压实现的，同时还产生+0.
summaries.ja: 12-16 nmの電着グラフト層を有するAu/ジアリールエテン-ビオロゲン/Ti/Au分子接合に光照射すると、1Vでの整流比が300から2に低下し、これは順方向電流密度を200倍に増加させつつ逆バイアス電流をほとんど変化させないことによるもので、同時に+0.

title: Collision inside an atom: quantum ion-atom dynamics
abstract: Rydberg atoms occupy a central role in quantum science; their loosely bound outer electron gives rise to properties that enable quantum information processing1 or the formation of exotic molecular bonds2. Beyond these roles, they have been proposed as a neutral platform for the observation of quantum effects in collisions and reactions of the ionic core with neutral particles3, 4, a long-standing goal of ion-based chemistry and physics. However, all of the experimental results so far could be explained using a classical description of the internuclear motion5. Here we demonstrate cold collisions inside a Rydberg helium atom, achieved by merging helium Rydberg and ground-state helium beams and imaging individual scattering events. We resolve the fully quantum-coherent motion and observe matter-wave diffraction and tunnelling-driven shape resonances down to collision energies of 90 mK. In the case of identical helium nuclei, we demonstrate a new regime of identical-particle Mott interference6, where quantum statistics begin to govern the total scattering cross section. For distinct isotopes, we show the breakdown of the Born-Oppenheimer approximation and benchmark parameter-free, state-of-the-art theory. We directly measure the helium isotope ionization-energy difference to be 15.0 +/- 0.1 K. Our experiments establish Rydberg atoms as a platform for the direct observation of quantum dynamics with a general class of ions, atoms and molecules.

summaries.en: Cold collisions inside Rydberg helium atoms reveal fully quantum-coherent ion-atom motion, matter-wave diffraction, shape resonances, identical-particle Mott interference, and breakdown of the Born-Oppenheimer approximation down to 90 mK.
summaries.zh: 在里德堡氦原子内部的冷碰撞中，观测到了低至90 mK的完全量子相干离子-原子运动、物质波衍射、形状共振、全同粒子莫特干涉以及玻恩-奥本海默近似的失效。
summaries.ja: リュードベリヘリウム原子内部の冷衝突において、90 mKに至るまでの完全に量子的にコヒーレントなイオン-原子運動、物質波回折、形状共鳴、同種粒子モット干渉、およびボルン-オッペンハイマー近似の破綻が観測された。

title: Theory of Sub-Doppler Spectroscopy of Alkali Metal Vapors in the Field of Counterpropagating Bichromatic Laser Beams: Probe Beam Regime
abstract: Sub-Doppler resonances observed in miniature cells ($V \ll 1 cm^3$) with Rb or Cs atoms in the field of counterpropagating bichromatic laser beams are of interest for the creation of a miniature quantum frequency standard (QFS) of the optical range. However, a theory of these resonances that takes into full account the real structure of energy levels in an atom has not yet been constructed, which would make it possible to obtain explicit analytical expressions for the absorption coefficient of the medium. This paper addresses this gap using the density matrix formalism and the algebra of irreducible tensor operators. Namely, we obtained an analytical expression for the absorption coefficient of the probe beam in the presence of a more intense counterpropagating beam (pump-probe regime). Moreover, the calculations were carried out for arbitrary parameters of laser beam polarization, arbitrary angular momenta of optical dipole transitions in the atom and various relaxation processes. The constructed theory allows us to correctly take into account the simultaneous action of various nonlinear optical effects, in contrast to the simplified three-level model of the atom, and also to investigate the partial contribution of each of them to the overall observed resonant circuit. The analysis performed, in particular, made it possible to predict an increase in the amplitude of the sub-Doppler resonance when using counterpropagating light beams with opposite circular polarizations in relation to the configuration of counterpropagating beams with orthogonal linear polarizations, which is often used in practice.

summaries.en: A density-matrix theory using irreducible tensor operators derives an analytical expression for the probe-beam absorption coefficient in alkali-metal vapor subject to counterpropagating bichromatic laser beams, fully accounting for atomic level structure, arbitrary polarizations, angular momenta, and relaxation processes, and predicts enhanced sub-Doppler resonance amplitudes for opposite circular polarizations compared with orthogonal linear polarizations.
summaries.zh: 本文采用密度矩阵形式和不可约张量算子代数，推导出在相向传播双色激光场中碱金属蒸气探测光束吸收系数的解析表达式，完整考虑了原子能级结构、任意偏振、角动量及弛豫过程，并预测采用反向圆偏振光束时亚多普勒共振幅度比常用的正交线偏振配置更强。
summaries.ja: 密度行列形式と既約テンソル演算子代数を用いて、対向伝播二色レーザー場中のアルカリ金属蒸気におけるプローブ光吸収係数の解析的表現を、原子のエネルギー準位構造・任意の偏光・角運動量・各種緩和過程を完全に考慮して導出し、逆円偏光ビームが直交直線偏光配置よりサブドップラー共鳴振幅を増大させることを予測した。

title: Continuous-wave 148.4 nm Generation in Quasi-phase Matched BaMgF4
abstract: We report continuous-wave (CW) vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) generation at 148.4 nm by second-harmonic generation of 296.8-nm fundamental light in quasi-phase matched (QPM) BaMgF4 (BMF). At the incident power of 170 mW, a VUV output power of approximately 31 pW can be obtained. The quadratic dependence of the signal on the incident power in the QPM region and its attenuation in the ambient environment support the identification of VUV generation. The polarization dependence shows a sine-function shape with a 15% output attenuation from the maximum to the minimum. These results highlight the potential of BMF as a nonlinear medium for CW VUV generation.

summaries.en: Continuous-wave vacuum-ultraviolet light at 148.

summaries.ja: 準位相整合BaMgF4における296.

title: Mode locking by phase-sensitive amplification
abstract: Mode locking is the mechanism by which lasers organize many optical modes into stable trains of ultrashort pulses. It underpins optical frequency combs, precision timing and spectroscopy, and provides the phase-coherent waveforms required for applications ranging from strong-field physics to optical frequency metrology. Conventional pulse-forming mechanisms select pulse amplitude without fixing its phase relative to an external optical reference, leaving pulse formation and optical-phase stabilization as separate functions. Phase-sensitive amplification offers a different possibility: the optical reference can participate directly in pulse formation. Here we demonstrate this principle in a continuously pumped oscillator. Kerr-induced phase evolution and cavity detuning turn pump-referenced parametric gain into a power-dependent discriminator that supports stable single-soliton operation. Roundtrip-resolved interferometry reveals that the soliton optical phase remains referenced to the master laser modulo $\pi$. These results establish phase-sensitive mode locking, in which pulse-amplitude selection and optical-phase referencing arise from the same coherent nonlinear feedback.

summaries.en: By using Kerr nonlinearity and cavity detuning to turn pump-referenced parametric gain into a power-dependent discriminator, a continuously pumped oscillator achieves phase-sensitive mode locking in which stable single-soliton pulses form with their optical phase locked to the master laser modulo π, uniting pulse-amplitude selection and optical-phase referencing in one coherent feedback process.
summaries.zh: 通过利用克尔非线性与腔失谐将泵浦参考的参量增益转化为功率相关的鉴别器，连续泵浦振荡器实现了相位敏感锁模，形成稳定的单孤子脉冲，且其光学相位被锁定到主激光的π模，从而将脉冲幅度选择与光学相位参考统一于同一相干非线性反馈过程中。
summaries.ja: カー非線形性と共振器離調によりポンプ参照パラメトリック利得をパワー依存の弁別器へと変換することで、連続励起発振器は位相敏感モード同期を実現し、安定な単一ソリトンが主レーザーに対してπを法として位相固定されて発生し、パルス振幅選択と光位相参照が単一のコヒーレント非線形帰還から生じる。

title: Probing topological edge states in multilayer dielectric photonic nanostructures
abstract: Topological photonics has recently attracted a significant attention, leading to many theoretical studies and predictions. However, direct experimental demonstrations of topology-driven effects, particularly in nanostructures, are rarely proven. In this work, we experimentally investigate multilayer photonic nanostructures composed of alternating subwavelength dielectric layers, arranged according to the topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model. By engineering different edge truncations, we probe different supported topological phases. Our theoretical predictions and experimental measurements reveal strong field confinement at the surface exclusively in the configuration supporting topological edge states, providing their localized character and topological origin. First, we demonstrate enhanced absorption in an ultrathin absorbing overlayer deposited on the surface when the topological surface mode is present, highlighting the potential for surface-sensing applications. Second, we observe enhanced second-harmonic generation in reflection from the surface, demonstrating the potential of topological states for surface enhanced nonlinear optics enabled by the strong localization of the electromagnetic field at the interface.

summaries.en: By engineering edge truncations in multilayer dielectric photonic nanostructures based on the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, the authors experimentally demonstrate strongly confined topological edge states that enhance both surface absorption and second-harmonic generation.
summaries.zh: 通过对基于Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型的多层介电光子纳米结构进行边缘截断设计，作者实验证明了强局域的拓扑边缘态，并展示了其对表面吸收和二次谐波产生的增强效应。
summaries.ja: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型に基づく多層誘電体フォトニックナノ構造においてエッジ切断を設計することで、著者らは強く局在したトポロジカル端状態を実験的に実証し、表面吸収と第二高調波発生の両方を増強できることを示した。

title: Engineering Color and Angular Stability in Building-Integrated Photovoltaics Using Metal-Oxide Photonic Glasses
abstract: Coloring building-integrated photovoltaics poses a dilemma: absorptive pigments cost photocurrent, while ordered photonic structures are iridescent. Amorphous photonic glasses, disordered packings of high-index nanospheres, are proposed to avoid both, yet their angle-independent color has rarely been quantified on a realistic module stack. A non-absorbing scatterer needs a high index with visible transparency, which the Moss rule caps near 2.35. Coupling Mie scattering, the Percus-Yevick structure factor, the exact phase function, and two-flux transfer with absorption and refraction at the front glass, we fix four target colors that a crowd-sourced naming survey calls unambiguously blue, green, gold, and terracotta, and map the recipes reaching them across four metal oxides, four encapsulants, two cell technologies, and wide ranges of particle size, packing fraction, and layer number. All four are reached in a laminated three-layer coating, to within DeltaE00 of 0.8 to 2.5, but not from one oxide: transparent TiO2 renders the blue and only pale warm tones; the green, gold, and terracotta require the blue-band absorption of V2O5, and the low-contrast oxides turn grey at the warm end. The encapsulant governs the color, and the cell technology does not. Disorder does not confer angle independence: the colors hold for an observer moving under a fixed sun but drift by DeltaE00 of 5 to 18 over the day, terracotta least, and a facade lit from above and viewed from below shifts every color towards the blue. Oxide, layer number, and facade geometry must therefore be designed together.

summaries.en: Amorphous photonic-glass coatings made from metal oxides can achieve four target colors in a laminated three-layer stack, but the oxide choice, layer number, and facade geometry must be co-designed because disorder alone does not ensure angle independence.
summaries.zh: 由金属氧化物制成的非晶光子玻璃涂层可在三层叠层中实现四种目标颜色，但必须协同设计氧化物种类、层数和立面几何结构，因为无序性本身并不能保证角度无关性。
summaries.ja: 金属酸化物からなるアモルファスフォトニックグラスコーティングは三層積層で四つの目標色を実現できるが、無秩序性だけでは角度無依存性は得られないため、酸化物の種類、層数、ファサード形状を協調設計する必要がある。

title: On the Fast Electrons-Optical Modes Interaction Problem Error
abstract: A recently developed relativistic quantum optics approach for a fast electron beam-optical modes interaction problem (Optica 6, 1524--1534 (2019)) contains suggestion about a smallness of the error induced by replacement $\Psi_{\vec k}\approx\Psi_{\vec k_0}$ for noninteracting free electron Dirac spinors at such wave vector $\vec k$ that $\left|\vec k-\vec k_0 \right| \ll\left|\vec k_0\right|$ with $\vec k_0$ as a peaked wave vector of a focused electron beam. Here, based on quantum information approach we strictly investigated a degree of coincidence of spinors $\Psi_{\vec k}$ and $\Psi_{\vec k_0}$ by calculating fidelity for them. The analytical expression is obtained. It is shown that the fidelity inevitably depends on not only wave vectors $\vec k$ and $\vec k_0$ but also on mutual orientation of $[\vec k_0,\vec k]$ and $\hat{\vec{s}}^{\dagger}\vec{\sigma}\hat{\vec{s}}$ with $\vec{s}$ is a two-component spin unit vector and $\vec{\sigma}$ is a vector of Pauli matrices. This result can be conceived as a chirality-like effect in the fidelity and constraints spin arbitrariness when applying the developed relativistic quantum optics approach to the problems of interest. A geometrical configuration of $\vec k_0$, $\vec k-\vec k_0$, and $\hat{\vec{s}}^†\vec\sigma\hat{\vec{s}}$ that is optimal in terms of fidelity is established.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: Using a quantum-information fidelity analysis, the paper shows that approximating free-electron Dirac spinors as Ψ_k ≈ Ψ_k0 in fast-electron–optical-mode interaction problems introduces an error that depends on the wave vectors and the mutual orientation of [k0,k], thereby imposing a chirality-like constraint on the electron spin.
summaries.zh: 通过量子信息保真度分析，本文表明在快速电子与光学模式相互作用问题中将自由电子狄拉克旋量近似为Ψ_k ≈ Ψ_k0会引入依赖于波矢以及[k0,k]相对取向的误差，从而对电子自旋施加了类似手征性的约束。
summaries.ja: 量子情報の忠実度解析により、高速電子と光学モードの相互作用問題で自由電子ディラック・スピノルをΨ_k ≈ Ψ_k0と近似すると、波数ベクトルと[k0,k]の相対配向に依存する誤差が生じ、電子スピンにカイラリティ様の制約が課されることが示された。

title: Fast continuous ion transport through X-junctions with low motional excitation for QCCD architectures
abstract: Trapped ion quantum computing based on the quantum charge coupled device (QCCD) architecture uses functional zoning and ion transport to enable high fidelity computation and all to all qubit connectivity. As trapped ion quantum processing units (QPU) scale, 90° X-junction turns account for an increasing fraction of total transport time. Frequent junction crossings, therefore, make transport speed and final phonon excitation direct determinants of quantum algorithm execution efficiency. However, complex electric fields in X-junctions complicate waveform design, making it difficult to achieve high speed and low final phonon excitation simultaneously. Here, we develop a waveform design method for low-phonon-excitation high-speed X-junction(LHX-T) transport. It integrates low barrier pseudopotential channel design using multiple radio frequency (Multi-RF), multidimensional shortcut to adiabaticity dynamics, and constrained DC voltage optimization over the entire transport sequence. This framework connects waveform design, control, and computational validation, with smooth multichannel waveforms computed rapidly through a Karush-Kuhn-Tucker(KKT) linear system. The resulting waveform transports a single $^{171}Yb^+$ ion through a 90° turn in $5\mu s$ at an average speed of 14.6 m/s. Over 50 consecutive round trips, the final equivalent coherent phonon number consistently stays below 0.001, with no noticeable accumulation over time. System level evaluations at the QCCD scale show that the median duration of a single execution cycle is reduced by about $30\%$ across various circuit types. The fraction of execution time spent on transport decreases from approximately $70\%$ to $55\%$. This approach offers a means of designing fast ion transport waveforms with low phonon excitation for scalable QCCD based QPUs and provides a technical basis for efficient execution of quantum algorithms.

summaries.en: A waveform design framework combining Multi-RF pseudopotential channel engineering, multidimensional shortcut-to-adiabaticity dynamics, and constrained DC voltage optimization transports a single 171Yb+ ion through a 90-degree X-junction in 5 microseconds at 14.

title: Scalability and performance metrics for boson sampling devices
abstract: Linear-optical platforms provide a promising route to demonstrate quantum computational advantage, particularly through the boson sampling problem. While a boson sampling system should be large enough to show the quantum advantage, the size of the boson sampling problem is often restricted by experimental constraints. In particular, as a boson sampling system is scaled up, experimental constraints can limit its effective problem size to permit efficient classical simulation. In this paper, we investigate the theoretical scalability bounds for boson sampling systems under practical experimental conditions, including photon loss, mode mismatch, and input state error. We employ non-negativity conditions for phase-space quasiprobability distribution functions to analyze these effects. In addition, we introduce two device-level metrics, the boson sampling score which measures the usable capacity of a given device and the boson sampling volume which provides a common hardware-level benchmark for comparing different platforms and assessing their access to an advantage-relevant problem size regime. Our results provide fundamental insights into the performance of boson sampling systems under realistic experimental conditions and offer practical guidelines for scaling up boson sampling systems.

summaries.en: This paper uses phase-space quasiprobability non-negativity conditions to derive theoretical scalability bounds for boson sampling systems under photon loss, mode mismatch, and input state error, and introduces the device-level boson sampling score and boson sampling volume metrics for benchmarking usable capacity and hardware performance.
summaries.zh: 本文利用相空间准概率分布函数的非负性条件，推导了在光子损耗、模式失配和输入态误差等实际实验条件下玻色采样系统的理论可扩展性界限，并提出了玻色采样得分和玻色采样体积这两个器件级指标，用于衡量设备可用容量和比较不同硬件平台。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、位相空間準確率分布関数の非負性条件を用いて、光子損失・モード不整合・入力状態誤差といった実際の実験条件下でのボソンサンプリング系の理論的なスケーラビリティ限界を解析し、デバイスの有効容量を測るボソンサンプリングスコアとハードウェア比較用のボソンサンプリングボリュームという二つのデバイスレベル指標を導入する。

title: Partial-coherence weak measurement of polarization qubits with a temporal pointer: theory and experiment
abstract: Weak measurement has proven useful for metrology, for probing quantum paradoxes, and for the direct measurement of quantum states. Weak measurements of polarization qubits with temporal pointers provide a direct route to weak-value characterization, including in regimes where the pointer is only partially coherent. We derive a closed-form expression for the post-selected temporal shift that interpolates between the incoherent and coherent (ideal) weak-measurement limits through a single parameter $\nu$, the pointer visibility. The expression is experimentally tested for a range of polarization states spanning three trajectories corresponding to rotations about the principal axes of the Poincaré sphere. Two of the trajectories provide parameter-free benchmarks, with the real part of the weak value following $\cos^2\theta$ and $1/2$. In contrast, the weak value along the third trajectory is sensitive to incoherence and is well described by the single-parameter partial-coherence model, from which a reduced pointer visibility is obtained. Time shifts are extracted from the smoothed derivative of the pulse leading edge with internal calibration, reaching few-picosecond precision on 10 ns optical pulses using commercial components. The same apparatus also gives qualitative access to the imaginary quadrature through the frequency centroid, showing that temporal weak measurements remain accessible and quantitative in partially coherent pulsed systems.

summaries.en: A closed-form single-parameter model of partially coherent temporal weak measurements of polarization qubits is derived and experimentally validated across three Poincaré-sphere trajectories using few-picosecond time-shift extraction on 10 ns pulses.
summaries.zh: 本文推导了偏振量子比特在部分相干时间指针下弱测量的单参数闭式模型，并在三条庞加莱球轨迹上通过10纳秒脉冲上的皮秒级时间位移提取进行了实验验证。
summaries.ja: 偏光量子ビットの部分コヒーレントな時間ポインターを用いた弱測定について、単一パラメータの閉形式モデルを導出し、10ナノ秒パルス上でピコ秒精度の時間シフト抽出によりポアンカレ球上の3つの軌道にわたって実験的に検証した。

title: Generative learning of time series with holographic quantum circuit sampling
abstract: Quantum generative models face growing qubit requirements and concentrated loss landscapes when learning long time series. Here we introduce holographic quantum circuit sampling (HQCS), which combines mid-circuit measurements, qubit reuse and independently parameterized temporal blocks to generate trajectories with a fixed number of qubits. For Haar-random HQCS and a normalized exponential kernel, we prove inverse-polynomial bounds on maximum mean discrepancy loss variance, contrasting with exponential concentration in global Haar-random generators. For generic members of a family of nonstationary Markov processes, temporal parameterization reduces exact-generation gate counts from quadratic to linear in sequence length relative to a specified class of repeated shared-block generators. Simulations demonstrate learning of Gaussian autoregressive processes and historical Volatility Index (VIX) trajectories, with the latter achieving over tenfold lower maximum mean discrepancy than the tested classical benchmarks. These results establish a framework for quantum time-series generation with fixed qubit requirements and provable avoidance of exponential loss concentration as sequence length grows.

summaries.en: Holographic quantum circuit sampling (HQCS) uses mid-circuit measurements, qubit reuse, and independently parameterized temporal blocks to generate long time series with a fixed number of qubits, achieving provable avoidance of exponential loss concentration and linear gate-count scaling.
summaries.zh: 全息量子电路采样（HQCS）利用中间电路测量、量子比特复用和独立参数化的时间块，以固定数量的量子比特生成长时间序列，可证明地避免了指数级损失集中，并实现线性门数缩放。
summaries.ja: ホログラフィック量子回路サンプリング（HQCS）は、中間回路測定、量子ビット再利用、独立にパラメータ化された時間ブロックを用いて、固定数の量子ビットで長い時系列を生成し、指数関数的な損失集中の回避と線形なゲート数スケーリングを証明可能に実現する。

title: Monogamy of quantum steering in exciton--cavity optomechanical system
abstract: In this work, we study a theoretical scheme to investigate the monogamy of quantum steering in a hybrid exciton--cavity optomechanical (EOM) system. Within the Gaussian-state formalism, we quantify the steerability among the exciton, photon, and mechanical modes in both the steady-state and dynamical regimes. We establish and verify CKW-type monogamy inequalities for Gaussian steering and demonstrate that the distribution of bipartite steering among the three modes can be controlled through the system parameters. We further examine the influence of thermal noise and temporal evolution on the steering properties and the corresponding monogamy relations. Our results show that increasing the temperature generally suppresses the strength of Gaussian steering and modifies the degree of steering sharing imposed by the CKW-type monogamy relations. In contrast, in the dynamical regime, the steerability can increase with evolution time over suitable temporal windows, indicating that the transient dynamics can be exploited to enhance quantum correlations. These results highlight the potential of hybrid exciton--optomechanical platforms for controllable quantum correlations and provide a promising route toward the generation and manipulation of multipartite quantum resources.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Other Condensed Matter (cond-mat.other); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: This paper theoretically studies CKW-type monogamy inequalities for Gaussian quantum steering among exciton, photon, and mechanical modes in a hybrid exciton-cavity optomechanical system, showing that steering distribution is tunable via system parameters and modified by thermal noise and transient dynamics.
summaries.zh: 本文从理论上研究了混合激子-腔光机械系统中激子、光子和机械模之间高斯量子导引的CKW型单配性不等式，表明导引分布可通过系统参数调控，并受热噪声和瞬态动力学影响。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ハイブリッド励起子―キャビティ光機械系における励起子・光子・機械モード間のガウス量子ステアリングに対するCKW型モノガミー不等式を理論的に研究し、ステアリング分布が系パラメータで制御可能であり、熱雑音と過渡ダイナミクスによって変化することを示した。

title: Photonic realization of an electromagnetic cavity field with uniform mirror motion
abstract: We perform a detailed mathematical study of the effective Hamiltonian describing a non-stationary electromagnetic cavity field, introduced by C.~K.~Law, in the presence of uniform linear motion. We find that the corresponding dynamical equations admit a unitary diagonalization and that the normalized velocity of motion satisfies the two-sided bound $\lvert v/c \rvert \lesssim 10.1716$. Although this result is mathematically consistent, the interval obtained is an order of magnitude larger than the physically admissible range $\lvert v/c \rvert < 1$. To address this limitation, we propose a reinterpretation of bosonic coupling terms as generators of the symplectic algebra $\mathrm{Sp}(4,\mathbb{R})$, identifying them with transformations that can be implemented through linear optical elements. Within this photonic approach, the coupling parameters are not restricted to small values, allowing us to explore regimes of strong effective interactions. In this case, we demonstrate the generation of two-mode squeezed states and derive analytical expressions for the average photon number in each mode. Furthermore, we analyze statistical properties that characterize mixedness and entanglement, including intermode correlations, the Mandel parameter, and the linear entropy. The corresponding Wigner function provides a phase-space visualization of the system's behavior, illustrating the connection between cavity motion, mode coupling, and nonclassical field correlations via the underlying symplectic algebra.

summaries.en: The paper studies the effective Hamiltonian of a uniformly moving electromagnetic cavity field, finds a unitary diagonalization with a mathematically consistent but physically too broad velocity bound, and reinterprets the bosonic couplings as symplectic Sp(4,R) generators implementable by linear optics to explore strong-coupling two-mode squeezed states, photon-number statistics, mixedness, entanglement, and the Wigner function.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了匀速运动的电磁腔场的有效哈密顿量，发现其动力学方程可幺正对角化且速度满足一个数学上自洽但物理上过宽的双边界，并将玻色耦合项重新解释为可由线性光学实现的辛代数Sp(4,R)生成元，从而在强耦合区探讨双模压缩态、平均光子数、混合度、纠缠及Wigner函数。
summaries.ja: 本論文は一様運動する電磁空洞場の有効ハミルトニアンを解析し、ユニタリ対角化と数学的には整合するが物理的には広すぎる速度の両側境界を見出し、ボソン結合項を線形光学で実装可能なシンプレクティック代数Sp(4,R)の生成子として再解釈することで、強結合領域における二モード圧縮状態、平均光子数、混合度、エンタングルメント、ウィグナー関数を調べた。

title: Two-axis twisting by two-photon exchange: rate, depth, and the self-Kerr constraint
abstract: The coherent exchange of pairs of quanta between two bosonic modes is equivalent, up to a numerical factor, to the generator of two-axis twisting, which attains Heisenberg scaling of the squeezing; we determine how much of that equivalence survives in a realistic nonlinear medium. In any such medium the exchange term is accompanied by a local Kerr nonlinearity, and within a sector of fixed particle number the Hamiltonian depends on a single dimensionless ratio of the effective Kerr strength to the exchange strength. We derive two criteria governing this ratio and show that they are independent. The first is the rate at which squeezing is generated: the exponential rate follows in closed form, vanishes exactly when the two strengths are equal in magnitude, and recovers as the square root of the detuning from that point. The second is the depth to which squeezing can be driven: at fixed particle number the attainable depth is a function of the anisotropy of the mean-field saddle alone, reaches the full two-axis-twisting value only for the isotropic saddle, and is independent of the rate, parameter sets sharing the same anisotropy but differing in rate by a sizeable factor giving depths that agree to every printed digit. The closed-form Gaussian dynamics reveals a pitfall: extracting rates from short-time data overestimates them by more than a factor of two unless the saddle is isotropic. An isotropic cubic nonlinearity imposes the value of the ratio where the rate vanishes, so realizing two-axis twisting by pair exchange requires detuning it; a moderate mismatch already recovers almost all of the optimal depth. We also explain why the constraint has not surfaced before: at two quanta the self-Kerr shifts the two coupled states equally, so the two twisting Hamiltonians are rigorously indistinguishable, the degeneracy being lifted only from four quanta.

summaries.en: The equivalence between coherent two-photon exchange in a nonlinear medium and two-axis twisting is governed by two independent criteria set by the ratio of Kerr to exchange strength: the squeezing rate, which vanishes at equal strengths and scales as the square root of the detuning, and the attainable depth, which depends only on the anisotropy of the mean-field saddle and reaches the full two-axis-twisting value only for an isotropic saddle.
summaries.zh: 非线性介质中相干双光子交换与双轴扭转的等价性由克尔强度与交换强度之比的两个独立判据决定：压缩速率在两者相等时为零并按偏离该点的平方根恢复，而可达深度仅依赖平均场鞍点的各向异性，只有各向同性鞍点才能达到完整的双轴扭转值。
summaries.ja: 非線形媒質におけるコヒーレントな二光子交換と二軸ツイストの等価性は、カー強度と交換強度の比が定める二つの独立な基準に支配される：スクイージング速度は両者が等しいとき消え、その点からのずれの平方根で回復し、到達可能な深さは平均場鞍点の異方性のみに依存し、等方的な鞍点でのみ完全な二軸ツイスト値に達する。

title: Violation of Bell-type Inequality in the Hanbury Brown-Twiss (HBT) Toy-Model: Quantum Correlations beyond Local-Realism
abstract: The Hanbury Brown-Twiss (HBT) effect marked a significant milestone in quantum optics by illustrating that intensity correlations can reveal inherently quantum features of light. Motivated by the structure of the original 8-mode HBT interferometer, we develop a simplified 4-mode toy-model that captures its essential physical ingredients while significantly reducing analytical complexity. Our toy-model provides an intuitive and well-structured framework for examining the desired correlation functions. We investigate whether our toy-model can exhibit genuinely non-classical behaviour by formulating and applying a Bell-type inequality tailored to its specific measurement configuration. Our analysis shows that the correlations generated by the toy-model violate the inequality, indicating the presence of non-local features that are incompatible with any classical hidden-variable description. The results highlight the power of simplified models in uncovering fundamental aspects of non-classicality in optical systems.

summaries.en: A simplified four-mode toy model inspired by the Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometer is shown to violate a tailored Bell-type inequality, revealing non-local quantum correlations that cannot be explained by local hidden-variable theories.
summaries.zh: 受Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉仪启发的简化四模玩具模型被证明违反了一个定制的Bell型不等式，揭示了无法用局域隐变量理论解释的非局域量子关联。
summaries.ja: ハンブリーブラウン・トゥイス干渉計に着想を得た簡略化された4モードトイモデルが、特注のベル型不等式に違反することを示し、局所隠れた変数理論では説明できない非局所的な量子相関を明らかにした。

title: End-to-End Fidelity and Rate Analysis for Zero-Added-Loss Multiplexing
abstract: Zero-added-loss multiplexing (ZALM)~[Phys. Rev. Appl. {\bf 19}, 054029 (2023)] is a midpoint-source scheme for entanglement distribution. Its quantum transmitter (QTX) employs two Sagnac sources of polarization-entangled pairs plus partial Bell-state measurements (BSMs) on their idler outputs to herald entanglement in their signal outputs, thus avoiding the switching losses suffered by other multiplexing approaches. When its Sagnac sources' spontaneous parametric downconverters (SPDCs) utilize $\chi^{(2)}$ crystals with phase-matched spectral islands, ZALM avoids the tradeoff between heralding efficiency and output-state fidelity incurred when conventional-crystal SPDCs' outputs are channelized by dense wavelength-division multiplexing filters. This paper reports an end-to-end fidelity and rate analysis for islands-based ZALM that includes: SPDC multipair emissions of all orders and partial-BSM losses in the ZALM QTX; loss in propagation from the ZALM QTX to Alice and Bob's quantum receivers (QRXs); loss and mode mismatch in the mode converters employed at Alice and Bob's QRXs; and loss in the partial-BSM loading of Alice and Bob's emissive quantum memories.

summaries.en: This paper presents an end-to-end fidelity and rate analysis of zero-added-loss multiplexing (ZALM) for entanglement distribution, accounting for SPDC multipair emissions, partial-Bell-state-measurement losses in the quantum transmitter, propagation losses, mode-converter loss and mode mismatch in the quantum receivers, and partial-BSM loading losses in emissive quantum memories.
summaries.zh: 本文对零附加损耗复用（ZALM）进行了端到端保真度和速率分析，涵盖了量子发射端中SPDC多对发射和部分贝尔态测量损耗、传播损耗、量子接收端模式转换器的损耗和模式失配，以及发射型量子存储器中部分贝尔态测量加载损耗。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ゼロ付加損失多重化（ZALM）のエンドツーエンドのフィデリティとレート解析を提示し、量子送信機におけるSPDC多対放出と部分ベル状態測定損失、伝搬損失、量子受信機のモード変換器における損失とモード不整合、および発光型量子メモリへの部分ベル状態測定ローディング損失を考慮している。

title: Adaptive Entanglement Witnessing for Two-Qubit Systems
abstract: Entanglement witnesses are a key instrument in determining the entanglement of unknown bipartite qubit systems without requiring a full tomography. Riccardi et al. (2020) proposed a set of two-qubit witnesses, denoted $\{W^3\}$, which require a set of local measurements in three bases. In this work we propose an additional set of witnesses, denoted $\{W^5\}$, that build on $\{W^3\}$ and require measurements in two additional bases. We present an adaptive two-step method that uses the measurement results obtained for $\{W^3\}$ to select which $W^5$ to evaluate. We computationally demonstrate that our adaptive two-step protocol can identify 72% of entangled states generated according to the methods of Roik et al. (2021) while requiring measurements in only five of the nine bases needed for full quantum tomography. Additionally, we experimentally verify the behavior of both sets of witnesses using polarization-entangled photon pairs.

summaries.en: This work introduces an adaptive two-step entanglement-witnessing protocol for two-qubit systems that extends the three-basis witnesses of Riccardi et al.
summaries.zh: 这项工作提出了一种针对双量子比特系统的自适应两步纠缠见证协议，在Riccardi等人的三基组见证基础上增加了一组五基组见证，并利用初始测量结果选择要评估的额外见证，从而仅需在完整量子层析所需九个基组中的五个上进行测量即可识别出72%的生成纠缠态，并用偏振纠缠光子对实验验证了这两组见证。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、Riccardiらによる3基底の証人を拡張した5基底の証人集合を用い、初期測定結果に基づいて追加の証人を適応的に選択する二量子ビット系の2段階エンタングルメント証人プロトコルを提案し、完全トモグラフィーに必要な9基底のうち5基底の測定のみで生成されたエンタングル状態の72%を識別できることを計算的に示すとともに、偏光エンタングル光子対を用いて両証人集合の挙動を実験的に検証した。

title: Multipolar Nanophotonics with Quantum Computers
abstract: Small particles respond to light through electric and magnetic patterns called multipoles. Their interference determines the direction of scattered light and affects the decay of nearby emitters. Larger nanoantenna arrays, metasurfaces, and other nanophotonic systems demand increasingly costly simulations to meet strict performance and reliability requirements. We show how to represent these responses with quantum bits (qubits) and use quantum circuits to calculate scattering and the Purcell effect, the change in an emitter's decay rate caused by its surroundings. The circuits can encode known multipoles or estimate unknown ones from Maxwell's equations at the particle surface. We test the method against classical theory using an ideal quantum simulator and real IBM and IonQ quantum computers. For a silicon nanoparticle of radius 78 nm illuminated at 679 nm, IonQ gives a forward directivity of 2.984, close to the ideal dipolar value 3, quantifying the concentration of scattered light in the forward direction. For an emitter 10 nm from a gold nanoparticle and emitting at 510 nm, IBM measurements yield a calculated total decay rate 20.48 times its vacuum value versus 20.47 from theory, with correction for errors in reading the qubit states. We also establish how the number of multipoles and the required accuracy set the demands on qubits and measurements. These results motivate quantum-assisted design studies of directional radiation and emitter decay in nanophotonic systems.

summaries.en: This paper demonstrates that quantum computers can faithfully compute multipolar scattering and Purcell decay in nanophotonic systems, with silicon and gold nanoparticle examples matching classical theory.
summaries.zh: 本文表明量子计算机能够忠实计算纳米光子学系统中的多极散射和珀塞尔衰减，硅和金纳米颗粒的示例与经典理论相符。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、量子コンピュータがナノフォトニクス系における多重極散乱とパーセル崩壊を忠実に計算できることを示し、シリコンと金のナノ粒子の例で古典理論と一致することを明らかにした。

title: Time-Frequency Continuous-Variable Quantum Teleportation with Single Photons
abstract: Quantum teleportation, a key building block for quantum technologies, enables distant parties, Alice and Bob, to transfer an unknown quantum state using entanglement, local operations, and classical communication. In this work, we propose a quantum teleportation protocol for single-photon time-frequency continuous variables, where time is the time of arrival at a detector. We detail the operational requirements of the protocol, notably the nonlinear interactions needed for the photon-photon time-frequency entangling gate. By explicitly treating the detector position as the reference frame for time of arrival, we show that, even with ideal classical and quantum channels, the input-output fidelity is not unity unless the receiving party can correct the detector-position mismatch. This results in a trade-off between teleportation fidelity and the temporal bandwidth of the input photon wavepacket. The protocol itself can be used for remote detector synchronization. In particular, we show that time-frequency cat and Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill states provide an internal temporal ruler through fidelity revivals. We further derive the classical and best-copy fidelity thresholds for single-photon Gaussian wavepackets, finding that the relevant vacuum-equivalent shot noise is input-dependent, in contrast with quadrature-based continuous-variable quantum teleportation. Our proposal derives from a quantum theory of space-time events, whereafter we establish space as a reference for the time degree of freedom, thereby grounding our work in ongoing research on reference frames and superselection rules in quantum optics and quantum information. Beyond protocols harnessing time-frequency continuous variables of single photons, this work points toward remote synchronization in quantum communication architectures.

summaries.en: A quantum teleportation protocol for single-photon time-frequency continuous variables is proposed, showing that fidelity is limited by detector-position mismatch unless corrected, which yields a trade-off with input temporal bandwidth and enables remote detector synchronization.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种针对单光子时频连续变量的量子隐形传态协议，表明除非修正探测器位置失配，否则保真度会受限，从而与输入时间带宽形成权衡，并可用于远程探测器同步。
summaries.ja: 本論文は単一光子の時間周波数連続変数に対する量子テレポーテーション協議を提案し、検出器位置の不一致を補正しない限り忠実度が制限され、入力の時間帯域幅とのトレードオフが生じ、遠隔検出器同期に利用できることを示す。

title: Collective Floquet engineering between two distant superconducting artificial atoms
abstract: A one-dimensional waveguide is a crucial medium for transferring propagating quantum information between remote qubits, yet the photon-mediated interaction is typically fixed by the static device geometry, qubit parameters, and their couplings to the transmission line. Such an interaction can be engineered to be coherent or dissipative via virtual- or real-photon exchange, respectively, yet its effective strength remains fixed in either case. Here we demonstrate dynamical control over this interaction by applying Floquet engineering to two superconducting qubits coupled to a waveguide terminated by a capacitive mirror. By positioning one qubit at an antinode and the other qubit at a node or an antinode of the resonant standing wave, we realize a Hermitian or non-Hermitian coupling between the two qubits. A periodic flux drive of the qubit frequencies then enables on-demand control of the coherent energy splitting and the collective decay. Our results establish Floquet engineering as a route to dynamically reshape both coherent and dissipative photon-mediated interactions between remote quantum emitters.

summaries.en: By periodically driving the frequencies of two superconducting qubits coupled to a mirror-terminated waveguide, the authors achieve dynamical Floquet control over both coherent and dissipative photon-mediated interactions between remote artificial atoms.
summaries.zh: 通过对耦合到端接电容镜波导的两个超导量子比特施加周期性频率驱动，作者实现了对远程人造原子之间相干和耗散光子介导相互作用的动力学Floquet调控。
summaries.ja: キャパシティブミラーで終端された導波路に結合した2つの超伝導量子ビットの周波数を周期的に駆動することで、遠隔の人工原子間のコヒーレントおよび散逸的な光子媒介相互作用を動的にフロケ制御することに成功した。

title: Metasurface quantum graphs for polarization-independent certified randomness
abstract: Quantum random number generators are crucial for information security, yet existing implementations are hindered by bulky optics, device imperfections, and state alignment constraints. Here, using a compact metasurface platform, we achieve polarization-independent certified randomness by establishing a quantitative quantum graph framework. By mapping multi-channel nanophotonic responses onto graph vertices, we assign metasurface measurements an operational information-theoretic meaning, directly connecting weighted graph degrees to conditional min-entropy estimation. The resulting graph-certified measurements yield robust private randomness even under entanglement-based attacks without complex optics. Experimentally, we fabricate 4- and 6-channel dielectric metasurfaces to implement high-dimensional positive operator-valued measure graphs, successfully certifying randomness with heralded single photons and Poissonian light. By integrating complex quantum measurements into a single passive layer, our metasurface quantum graphs provide a scalable route for integrated quantum technologies.

summaries.en: A metasurface quantum graph framework enables polarization-independent certified randomness by mapping multi-channel nanophotonic responses onto graph vertices for direct conditional min-entropy estimation.
summaries.zh: 超表面量子图框架通过将多通道纳米光子响应映射到图顶点，直接估计条件最小熵，从而实现与偏振无关的可认证随机性。
summaries.ja: メタサーフェス量子グラフの枠組みは、多チャネルナノフォトニック応答をグラフ頂点に写像して条件付きミニエントロピーを直接推定することで、偏光に依存しない認定ランダム性を実現する。

title: Towards the Geometry of Quantum Optical Measurements: Kraus Trajectories in the Instrumental Weyl-Heisenberg Group Manifold
abstract: Since ancient Greek times, geometry has been a method by which humans can make inferences, by the use of similar triangles, about the world far beyond their immediate senses. Similarity plays an equally important role in quantum measurement, except that instead of triangles, the similarity is between the infinitesimal generators of rotation, canonical transformation, or some other virtual symmetry. For many quantum optical measurements of a single mode, these generators produce Kraus operators that are contained within a twelve-dimensional Lie group: the Instrumental Weyl-Heisenberg group manifold ($\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$). In particular, $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ is general enough to include all diffusively generated 'dyne measurements. In this paper, $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ will be used to develop two more general classes of 'dyne measurement: one that interpolates between diffusive homodyne and diffusive heterodyne (``slomodyne'') and one that adds to 'dyne measurements adaptive squeezing and displacement. Our analysis uses an approach known as the Instrument Manifold Program (IMP). In particular, a Harish-Chandra-like decomposition of $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ is used to calculate the vielbein transformation from a right-invariant basis to the corresponding coordinate basis, allowing us to universally and autonomously navigate $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ and locate the Kraus-operator of whatever selective process is being considered as it evolves in time according to the measurement record.

summaries.en: This paper uses the Instrument Manifold Program and a Harish-Chandra-like decomposition of the twelve-dimensional Instrumental Weyl-Heisenberg group manifold to geometrically describe Kraus trajectories for quantum optical measurements, including generalized 'dyne measurements that interpolate between homodyne and heterodyne detection and incorporate adaptive squeezing and displacement.
summaries.zh: 本文利用仪器流形程序（IMP）以及十二维仪器Weyl-Heisenberg群流形的类Harish-Chandra分解，几何地描述量子光学测量的Kraus轨迹，包括在零差与外差探测之间插值并加入自适应压缩和位移的广义dyne测量。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、計器多様体プログラム（IMP）と12次元計器的Weyl-Heisenberg群多様体のHarish-Chandra型分解を用いて、ホモダイン検出とヘテロダイン検出の中間や適応的スクイージングと変位を加えた一般化dyne測定を含む量子光学測定のKraus軌道を幾何学的に記述する。

title: Realistic simulation of universal multiport interferometers with losses within a Gaussian formalism
abstract: Photonic technologies are among the leading platform contenders for demonstrating quantum advantage. Nevertheless, photon losses represent the major hurdle for the realization of a fault-tolerant optical quantum computer, and the need for an accurate characterization of this phenomenon is crucial for classical simulations of quantum algorithms on noisy backends. The noisy regime would require the simulation of the algorithm on a Fock backend or rather assuming the a priori hypothesis on the uniformity of the optical losses, which may lead to wrong predictions about the outcome from the algorithm on a cerain hardware. We propose a Gaussian model that can reproduce a lossy dynamics through the experimental characterization of imperfect interferometers, yielding the corresponding mean vector and the covariance matrix. Such model can be adapted to any continuous-variable architecture (spatial or time-bin encoded) and for both the Gaussian boson sampling or general-dyne based algorithms. Eventually, we quantify the drift of optical losses from being uniform throughout the multiport interferometer by a numerical simulation. This work proposes a blueprint for future characterizations, tailor-suited for specific devices and architectures, as well as for potential error correction and mitigation techniques, and it paves the way for realistic simulations of quantum algorithms on NISQ optical platforms.

summaries.en: This work presents a Gaussian model for realistic simulation of lossy universal multiport interferometers by experimentally characterizing imperfect devices to obtain the corresponding mean vector and covariance matrix, applicable to any continuous-variable architecture and both Gaussian boson sampling and general-dyne algorithms.
summaries.zh: 这项工作提出了一种高斯模型，通过实验表征不完美的干涉仪以获得相应的均值向量和协方差矩阵，从而实现对有损耗的通用多端口干涉仪的真实模拟，适用于任何连续变量架构以及高斯玻色采样和广义测量算法。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、不完全な干渉計を実験的に特徴付けることで対応する平均ベクトルと共分散行列を得るガウスモデルを提案し、損失のある万能マルチポート干渉計の現実的なシミュレーションを可能にし、任意の連続変数アーキテクチャおよびガウスボソンサンプリングと一般化ダインドアルゴリズムの両方に適用できる。

title: Geodesic steering for rapid dissipative entanglement distribution
abstract: We describe an optimal-control strategy designed to accelerate the dissipative preparation of complex, highly entangled quantum many-body states. Analogous to optimal steering of isolated quantum systems, our scheme identifies control pulses that guide the evolution of open quantum systems along trajectories of instantaneous steady states while minimizing leakage resulting from non-adiabatic transitions. In many cases of interest, these control parameters can be derived analytically and without the need for computationally expensive numerical simulations of the full many-body master equation. We apply this technique for the preparation of bi- and multipartite entangled states in qubit systems coupled to a common photonic waveguide or a distributed squeezed reservoir. In both scenarios, our optimal-control strategy significantly outperforms the bare relaxation dynamics after a quench, reducing preparation times of near-maximally entangled states by orders of magnitude. This drastic speedup makes dissipative entanglement distribution protocols compatible with high-fidelity quantum information processing applications and illustrates more broadly the potential of leakage minimization for accelerating reservoir-engineering schemes.

summaries.en: An optimal-control strategy that steers open quantum systems along instantaneous steady-state trajectories dramatically reduces the time required for dissipative preparation of highly entangled many-body states in qubit systems coupled to a common photonic waveguide or squeezed reservoir.
summaries.zh: 一种最优控制策略通过沿着瞬时稳态轨迹引导开放量子系统，大幅缩短了在耦合到公共光子波导或压缩库的量子比特系统中耗散制备高度纠缠多体态所需的时间。
summaries.ja: 瞬時定常状態の軌跡に沿って開放量子系を誘導する最適制御戦略により、共通のフォトニック導波路やスクイーズドリザバーに結合した量子ビット系で高度に絡み合った多体状態を散逸的に生成する時間が大幅に短縮される。

title: Bosonic unstructured search: quantum enhancement without entanglement
abstract: We consider unstructured search using multimode bosonic quantum systems under energy constraints. The task is to locate an unknown marked mode among $N$ possibilities using arbitrary control, subject to a time-averaged mean-boson-number budget $n_{\text{b}}\gg 1$. We analyze a continuous-time phase-shift oracle of strength $B_{0}$, with cost given by the total oracle time, and a discrete oracle with fixed phase $\phi_{0}$, with cost given by the number of queries. We give algorithms that identify the target with query complexity $O(\sqrt{N}/{n_{\text{b}}}B_{0})$ for continuous-time oracles or $O(\sqrt{N}/n_{\text{b}} |{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|)$ for discrete oracles with $n_{\text{b}} |{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|=O(1)$. In contrast, for discrete oracles with $n_{\text{b}} |{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|=\Omega(1)$, we provide an algorithm using $O(\max\{1,\sqrt{N/n_{\text{b}}|{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|}\})$ queries. We also prove matching lower bounds on the query complexity, showing that these algorithms are asymptotically optimal. Furthermore, we show that, in the absence of loss, non-Gaussianity is necessary to achieve the optimal joint query scaling in $N$ and $n_{\text{b}}$, but entanglement is not. Under uniform boson loss at rate $\gamma$, we prove a query lower bound of $\Omega ( \gamma N / n _{\text{b}} B_{0}^{2} )$, attained for $\gamma = \Omega(B_{0} \sqrt{n _{\text{b}}/N})$ using coherent-state probes. Finally, we propose experimental implementations using multipass optical microscopy or superconducting circuits as potential routes to speeding up imaging or device calibration with a low boson-number budget.

summaries.en: This paper shows that multimode bosonic systems can achieve an asymptotically optimal quadratic quantum speedup for unstructured search using only non-Gaussian states and coherent probes, without requiring entanglement, even under boson loss.

title: Ghost unitaries for loss-resilient photonic resource-state generation
abstract: Entangled few-photon states, such as Bell and Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states, are central resources for discrete-variable photonic quantum information processing. In many architectures, these states are generated probabilistically by first heralding single photons from biphoton sources and then interfering them in linear-optical circuits. In this work, we show that the entanglement structure of said biphoton sources can be directly exploited for noise-engineering to deliver higher quality resource states. Using the transpose identity of multi-mode squeezed vacuum states, we introduce "ghost-unitary" implementations in which the target resource-generation interferometer is applied to the heralding modes rather than to the delivered resource modes. When the dominant imperfection is interferometric loss, this relocation converts direct amplitude damping of the output into false-positive heralding events that require both higher-pair emission and photon loss. In the low-squeezing regime, these events are parametrically suppressed, yielding higher-fidelity conditional resource states. We analyze this mechanism for single-qubit states, two-photon NOON states, Bell states, and a family of $n$-qubit GHZ states, as well as for single-qubit teleportation and type-I-fusion-based resource growth. Across these examples, we delineate finite parameter regimes in which ghost-unitary implementations outperform direct implementations, with particular relevance to frequency-bin photonics where active linear-optical transformations can be relatively lossy. We also prove that, in the setting considered here, the direct implementation of the $n$-GHZ family delivers identically damped outputs: equivalent to the ideal state followed by uniform amplitude damping. This extends the known $n=2,3$ cases and provides a structural result of independent interest for photonic quantum information processing.

summaries.en: The paper introduces 'ghost-unitary' implementations that relocate the resource-generation interferometer to the heralding modes of a squeezed-vacuum biphoton source, converting dominant interferometric loss into parametrically suppressed false-positive heralding events and thereby yielding higher-fidelity photonic Bell, NOON, and GHZ states in the low-squeezing regime.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了“幽灵幺正”实现方案，将资源生成干涉仪转移到压缩真空双光子源的预报模式上，从而将主要的干涉损耗转化为在低压缩区域被参数性抑制的假阳性预报事件，进而获得保真度更高的光子 Bell 态、NOON 态和 GHZ 态。

title: Periodic-Pulse Control of Collective Emission and Photon Statistics in Interacting Quantum Emitters
abstract: We investigate the collective emission spectra and photon correlations of two identical dipole-dipole-coupled emitters under continuous-wave (CW) and periodic pulsed driving. Our results show that a periodic train of instantaneous $\pi_x$ pulses can generate emission spectra whose dominant features closely resemble those obtained under CW excitation. We find that the structure of the collective emission spectra reflects the interplay among the resonance conditions, dipole-dipole coupling, and the inter-pulse delay $\tau_D$. We further demonstrate that finite-duration $\pi_x$ pulses with sufficiently high Rabi frequencies can closely reproduce the ideal instantaneous-pulse limit. In contrast to the emission spectra, the photon correlations $g^{(2)}(t,\tau)$ are governed primarily by $\tau_D$ and, unlike under CW driving, become increasingly insensitive to the resonance conditions in the short-pulse limit. These results establish periodic pulsed driving as a versatile means of tailoring both the emission spectra and the photon statistics of coupled two-emitter systems.

summaries.en: Periodic trains of instantaneous and finite-duration π_x pulses can reproduce the collective emission spectra of two dipole-dipole-coupled emitters under continuous-wave driving, while their photon correlations are controlled mainly by the inter-pulse delay and become insensitive to resonance conditions in the short-pulse limit.

title: Coherent optical control of a thousand qubits in a three-dimensional trapped-ion crystal
abstract: Leading quantum platforms are largely limited to one or two dimensions, whereas three-dimensional Coulomb crystals of trapped ions self-assemble into dense qubit arrays with no rearrangement overhead. Coherent optical control of such crystals has nonetheless been out of reach, because the optical transition couples to nearly all $3N$ collective modes, i.e., a thermally occupied quasi-continuum bath. Here we cool about 3,600 modes of a crystal of over 1,200 ions below single-phonon occupation, using a continuous cooling band that spans more than five octaves in vibrational spectrum, from about 50 kHz to 2.1 MHz. The crystal then serves as a register of optical qubits, allowing global initialization, coherent manipulation and collective detection. We demonstrate ensemble optical coherence of 21.6 milliseconds and reduce the optical-transition frequency uncertainty from 389 Hz for a single ion to 12 Hz for over a thousand ions, approaching the expected projection-noise scaling. Our approach could be extended to even larger crystals with phonon-mediated many-body couplings, opening a route towards entanglement-enhanced precision metrology and three-dimensional quantum simulation, particularly with spatial-shaped illumination for region-resolved collective control.

title: Boson Sampling Using Fock States from On-Demand Single Photon Source Arrays: Quantum Complexity & Impact of Dephasing
abstract: Boson sampling with array of on-demand single photons (discreet variable Fock states) as resource states provides distinct advantages in complexity scaling compared to single photon resource states mimicked by the states (continuous variable) generated in nonlinear photonics. Recent progress in realization of regular ordered array of mesa top single quantum dots (MTSQDs) enabling on-demand generation of many photon resource states with high single photon purity and indistinguishability [1,2] has opened the possibility of implementing chip-scale Boson sampling with single photons. An important question towards scale up of such circuits is how the dephasing and decay timescale of individual on-demand single photons affect the final probability distribution of the N-photon entangled state. In this work we report a framework that provides direct link between the physical sources of decoherence to the outcome of multiphoton correlation measurements. We explicitly incorporate the symmetrization of the N-photon states while accounting for the shape of the individual wave packets and dephasing. Using this framework, we show predictive estimates of the probability of generation of a 4-photon NOON state using an optical circuit initialized with 4 identical single photon wave packets, mimicking the emitted photons from MTSQD single photon sources reported in [2]. Specifically, we show how the probability of generating various 4-photon entangled states depend on the two-photon interference visibility which is determined by the pure dephasing timescale in relation to the radiative decay timescale. The results provide quantitative guidelines to measure 4 photon and higher number of entangled photon states generated in an optical circuit with on demand single photon sources and provide a link between physical processes such as temperature and the output state of the quantum optical circuits.

summaries.en: This work presents a framework linking the physical sources of decoherence in on-demand single-photon sources to the output of multiphoton correlation measurements, showing how two-photon interference visibility governed by the pure dephasing timescale relative to the radiative decay timescale determines the probabilities of generating 4-photon entangled states such as NOON states in boson sampling circuits.

summaries.ja: 本研究は、オンデマンド単一光子源におけるデコヒーレンスの物理的起源を多光子相関測定の結果に直接結びつける枠組みを提示し、純粋位相緩和時間と輻射減衰時間の比で決まる二光子干渉の可視度が、ボソンサンプリング回路における4光子NOON状態などのもつれ状態生成確率をどのように左右するかを示した。

title: Broadening the reflection band of atomic mirrors by engineering the emitter-waveguide coupling
abstract: We theoretically investigate single-photon coherent transport through a finite waveguide quantum electrodynamics (QED) array with spatially modulated emitter-waveguide couplings. By combining exact scattering calculations with spectral factorization and a semiclassical WKB analysis, we identify how the coupling profile controls the reflection bandwidth and its finite-size dependence. A Gaussian transverse displacement produces an exponential-of-Gaussian decay-rate profile that broadens the high-reflectivity window and suppresses the boundary-induced Fabry-Perot oscillations compared with a uniform array. The transmission zeros remain exactly degenerate at the atomic resonance for arbitrary positive coupling profiles at non-Bragg spacings. In contrast, the collective poles reorganize under the spatial modulation, redistributing their radiative widths and preventing individual subradiant resonances from terminating the reflection window. We further derive an algebraic 1/N scaling law for the contraction of the bandwidth toward its bulk value. The bulk bandwidth is determined by the largest local decay rate, whereas the finite-size correction increases as the profile becomes sharper, leading to an optimal profile width. These results establish spatial coupling engineering as a practical tool for designing broadband atomic mirrors in atom-nanofiber and circuit-QED platforms.

summaries.en: Spatially modulating the emitter-waveguide coupling in a finite waveguide-QED array broadens the high-reflectivity window of atomic mirrors by flattening Fabry-Perot oscillations and reorganizing collective poles, with an optimal profile width set by a 1/N scaling law.

title: Scalable long-distance quantum fan-out gates with reduced resource overhead
abstract: Scalable long-distance quantum gates are essential for distributed quantum computation and scalable quantum networks. We propose an efficient scheme for implementing an $n$-qubit fan-out gate $C^n$ (also known as a controlled-NOT-$\cdots$-NOT gate) across spatially separated parties. Our protocol requires only a pre-shared $n$-qubit Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state, $n$ local controlled-NOT (CNOT) gates, and feed-forward operations, thereby reducing both the CNOT and Hadamard gate counts by $(n-2)$ when compared with the standard decomposition-based approach. We further develop two optical architectures to implement the heralded and post-selected $n$-photon fan-out gates, respectively. These schemes require fewer single photons resources and achieve higher success probabilities than their decomposition-based counterparts, representing significant improvements. The results indicate that our approach is experimentally feasible and pave the way toward practical long-distance quantum computation.

summaries.en: This paper proposes an efficient scheme for long-distance n-qubit fan-out gates that uses only a pre-shared n-qubit GHZ state, n local CNOT gates, and feed-forward operations, reducing CNOT and Hadamard gate counts by n-2 and enabling heralded and post-selected optical implementations with fewer single-photon resources and higher success probabilities.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种高效的长距离n量子比特扇出门方案，仅需预先共享的n量子比特GHZ态、n个局域CNOT门和前馈操作，将CNOT门和Hadamard门数量各减少n-2个，并实现了所需单光子资源更少、成功概率更高的预报式和后选择式光学架构。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、事前共有されたn量子ビットGHZ状態、n個の局所CNOTゲート、フィードフォワード操作のみを用いて長距離n量子ビットファンアウトゲートを効率的に実装する方式を提案し、CNOTゲート数とHadamardゲート数をn-2削減するとともに、より少ない単一光子資源でより高い成功確率を達成するヘラルド型およびポストセレクション型の光学アーキテクチャを実現する。

title: Spectrally enhanced gravitational redshift signals in photonic interferometry
abstract: Quantum mechanics and general relativity are remarkably successful, yet their joint predictions remain beyond direct experimental reach. Photonic interferometers operating in a gravitational field offer a promising route to test this regime: gravitational redshift differentiates photon propagation between vertically separated arms, leading to a predicted phase shift and reduction in interference visibility. These effects are minute on laboratory scales, motivating existing proposals to consider large interferometer areas to accumulate them geometrically. Indeed, such schemes typically require kilometre-scale optical paths to produce appreciable interferometric signals. Here, we propose a strategy that replaces geometric accumulation with spectral enhancement by coupling the two interferometer arms to optical scatterers based on ultranarrow atomic transitions. These transitions serve as local spectral references: gravitational redshift changes the photon's detuning from each resonance, producing large differences in reflection amplitude and hence substantial visibility loss and interferometric phase shift already for centimetre-scale height differences. We quantify the experimental requirements and assess the feasibility of implementation with current or near-term technology. Our proposal thus opens a route to tabletop optical tests of the interplay between quantum mechanics and general relativity.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology (gr-qc)

summaries.en: By coupling the two arms of a photonic interferometer to ultranarrow atomic transition-based optical scatterers that act as local spectral references, gravitational redshift produces large reflection-amplitude differences and thus substantial visibility loss and phase shift even for centimetre-scale height differences, enabling tabletop optical tests of quantum mechanics and general relativity.

title: Towards an autonomous optomechanical Maxwell Demon engine
abstract: We present a fully autonomous model of a mechanical Maxwell demon engine that converts heat absorbed by a qubit into population inversion in an attached quantum battery. A damped mechanical oscillator acts as a pointer that incorporates the essential demon function of information acquisition about the qubit state and subsequent feedback into the system dynamics, replacing external measurements and control operations. This is achieved by means of a Holstein-type Hamiltonian, which makes the pointer's equilibrium position depend on the qubit state and thereby induces a state-dependent resonance shift. The mechanism enables a selective energy transfer to an attached spin system that acts as the quantum battery. We derive both local and global Lindblad master equations for the coupled system and identify the parameter regimes in which the engine operates efficiently. The figure of merit is the resulting steady-state population inversion of the battery, quantified in terms of ergotropy. Based on these results, we discuss the necessary conditions for practical implementations of the demon engine on realistic experimental platforms.

summaries.en: A fully autonomous optomechanical Maxwell demon engine is proposed in which a damped mechanical pointer acquires information about a qubit's state via a Holstein-type Hamiltonian and feeds it back to selectively transfer energy into a quantum battery, with ergotropy quantifying the resulting steady-state population inversion.

title: A complete quantum process model for physically realistic photo-detection in the joint photon-number and spectral degrees of freedom
abstract: Photo-detection is a fundamental component of experimental photonics, yet theoretical models often treat detectors solely in the photon-number basis, neglecting other relevant degrees of freedom such as spectral characteristics. We present a complete quantum process model for physically realistic photodetection that incorporates both photon-number effects and frequency-dependent detector response, described through explicitly derived Kraus operators in the operator-sum representation. This formalism accommodates realistic inefficiencies, models detection within finite spectral windows, and can be directly substituted for idealized models in quantum optical analyses. The model leads to identifying the suitable detection window of the detectors relative to the spectral distribution of incident photons and conversely, in order to maximize the observability of quantum effects.

summaries.en: This paper presents a complete quantum process model for physically realistic photodetection that incorporates both photon-number effects and frequency-dependent detector response through explicitly derived Kraus operators, enabling identification of optimal detection windows relative to incident photon spectra to maximize quantum effect observability.

title: Quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing with machine-learning estimation
abstract: Massive mechanical oscillators couple directly to forces, accelerations and gravity, making them attractive probes of new physics and of quantum mechanics at macroscopic scales. Pushing sensitivities beyond the standard quantum limit for signals of unknown phase requires non-Gaussian quantum states, whose metrological advantage has so far been confined to lighter systems such as trapped ions. Here we operate a microgram-scale acoustic mode of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator as a phase-insensitive quantum-enhanced sensor. A transmon qubit prepares the mode in Fock states of up to seven phonons by optimal control, and resolves its phonon-number distribution after interaction with a weak resonant signal. Bayesian analysis yields a Fisher information five times the vacuum value, a 7.0 dB gain in signal-amplitude sensitivity over any classical probe state, irrespective of its energy, currently limited by state preparation infidelities. We then train a neural network on the measured sensor response to perform Bayesian estimation without any analytical model of the system, showing the same sensitivity gain with half the systematic bias. Our results establish acoustic resonators prepared in non-Gaussian states as quantum-enhanced probes for high-frequency gravitational waves, dark matter and wave-function collapse.

title: Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model for Vessel Extraction Using Physics-informed Synthetic Data
abstract: Accurate artery extraction from X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is essential for coronary artery disease diagnosis and intervention. However, low vessel visibility, respiratory and cardiac motion, and limited annotations challenge existing methods. Moreover, most deep learning approaches produce binary vessel masks without preserving clinically relevant intra-arterial contrast information. We propose a Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model (TDBM) that formulates vessel extraction as image translation and learns from physics-informed synthetic data without manual vessel annotations. A physics-based XCA synthesis engine generates diverse, perfectly aligned pairs of contrast-enhanced and contrast-free images. Using these pairs, TDBM learns cross-domain mappings to recover high-fidelity vessel information. Temporal conditioning incorporates adjacent frames to improve consistency, while a vessel-aware contrastive loss exploits background-invariant synthetic pairs to enhance vascular discrimination. We evaluate TDBM on two XCA vessel segmentation datasets and conduct a reader study using two real-patient XCA sequence datasets. Zero-shot segmentation is further assessed on retinal imaging and fluorescence microscopy datasets. Results demonstrate that TDBM consistently outperforms existing methods and generalizes effectively across imaging modalities. Code and trained weights will be available at: this https URL

summaries.en: The Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model (TDBM) learns vessel extraction from physics-informed synthetic X-ray coronary angiography pairs, using temporal conditioning and a vessel-aware contrastive loss to outperform existing methods and generalize across retinal and fluorescence imaging without manual annotations.
