title: Mutual Coupling and Visibility Effects in 2D Holographic Curvature-Reconfigurable Apertures
abstract: Holographic multiple-input multiple-output arrays provide high spatial resolution and flexible wavefront control, but curved or conformal deployments jointly introduce curvature, mutual coupling (MC), and direction-dependent visibility. This paper studies a two-dimensional (2D) holographic curvaturereconfigurable aperture (HoloCuRA). A geometry-based model characterizes element positions, steering, and spatial correlation, while an impedance-based coupling matrix and a visibility vector capture electromagnetic interactions and shadowing. Relative directivity and spectral efficiency are evaluated versus curvature. Results show that MC mainly reshapes local directivity fluctuations, whereas visibility dominates the global pattern and spectral-efficiency variation under both isotropic scattering and CDL-A channels.

summaries.en: This paper models a 2D holographic curvature-reconfigurable aperture to show that mutual coupling mainly reshapes local directivity fluctuations while visibility dominates the global pattern and spectral-efficiency variation under isotropic scattering and CDL-A channels.
summaries.zh: 本文对二维全息曲率可重构孔径进行建模，结果表明互耦主要重塑局部方向性波动，而可见性在各向同性散射和CDL-A信道下主导全局方向图和频谱效率变化。
summaries.ja: 本論文は2次元ホログラフィック曲率再構成可能アパーチャをモデル化し、相互結合は主に局所的な指向性変動を再形成する一方、可視性が等方散乱およびCDL-Aチャネル下で全体パターンとスペクトル効率変動を支配することを示した。

title: Optimal Gating for Dead-Time-Constrained Single-Photon Detectors
abstract: We develop a Fisher-information framework for optimizing single-photon detector gating in periodic experiments, in contrast to previous more empirical or heuristic gating choices. After each photon detection, such a detector is insensitive for a dead time, so that an early background detection can obscure a later signal. Gating preserves availability for informative photons by selectively deactivating the detector. In our high-pile-up simulation of distance-attenuated lidar, our practical data-independent gating design reduces the worst-case asymptotic range variance by more than half relative to the free-running acquisition (which does not use any gating). More generally, we characterize achievable detector-active frequencies as a convex polytope and construct an adaptive rule that asymptotically attains an optimal "oracle" design without prior knowledge of the physical parameters. We also derive practical criteria that quantify the potential gains of gating and/or photon attenuation over unattenuated free-running acquisition.

summaries.en: A Fisher-information framework optimizes single-photon detector gating under dead-time constraints, yielding a practical data-independent design that halves worst-case asymptotic range variance in simulated high-pile-up lidar and an adaptive rule achieving oracle-optimal detector-active frequencies without prior parameter knowledge.
summaries.zh: 一个基于费舍尔信息的框架优化了死时间约束下单光子探测器的门控，其实际的数据无关门控设计在模拟的高堆积激光雷达中将最坏情况渐近距离方差减半以上，并构造了无需先验物理参数即可渐近达到最优"神谕"设计的自适应规则。
summaries.ja: フィッシャー情報量に基づく枠組みで単一光子検出器のデッドタイム制約下のゲーティングを最適化し、実用的なデータ非依存ゲーティング設計はシミュレーションされた高パイルアップLiDARにおいて最悪ケース漸近距離分散を半減以上に低減し、物理パラメータの事前知識なしに漸近的に最適な「オラクル」設計を達成する適応規則を構築した。

title: Background2Background: a self-supervised background removal framework for high dimensional microscopy
abstract: High-dimensional microscopy captures features across space, time, and spectrum, but complex backgrounds obscure signals. We present Background2Background (B2B), a self-supervised background removal framework leveraging the backgrounds larger correlation relative to the signal. Local pixel shuffling disrupts signal correlations while preserving background structure, transforming signals into effective noise for Noise2Noise-based background removal. Across fluorescence, stimulated Raman scattering and mid-infrared photothermal imaging, B2B achieves over 40-fold background suppression and reveals hidden signatures.
subjects: Image and Video Processing (eess.IV) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: Background2Background is a self-supervised framework that removes complex backgrounds in high-dimensional microscopy by exploiting the greater spatial correlation of background relative to signal through local pixel shuffling, achieving over 40-fold background suppression across fluorescence, stimulated Raman scattering, and mid-infrared photothermal imaging.
summaries.zh: Background2Background 是一个自监督背景去除框架，利用背景相比信号具有更强的空间相关性，通过局部像素打乱将信号转化为有效噪声以进行基于 Noise2Noise 的背景去除，在荧光、受激拉曼散射和中红外光热成像中实现超过40倍的背景抑制。
summaries.ja: Background2Backgroundは、信号よりも背景の空間相関が高いことを利用し、局所的なピクセルシャッフルによって信号を実効的なノイズに変換してNoise2Noiseベースの背景除去を行う自己教師ありフレームワークであり、蛍光・誘導ラマン散乱・中赤外光熱イメージングにおいて40倍以上の背景抑制を達成する。

title: Modeling and Design of a Diaphragm-Integrated Photonic Waveguide Microphone
abstract: Can an integrated optical readout improve the useful operating range of a miniature microphone? We address this question with an analytical model of a diaphragm carrying the sensing arm of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI). The model links pressure-induced bending to waveguide elongation and then to photocurrent, allowing mechanical sensitivity and optical detection limits to be assessed separately. Optical shot noise and back-cavity thermomechanical noise set the pressure resolution, while a 10% total harmonic distortion criterion defines acoustic overload. Two operating regimes are examined: a compact MEMS microphone with 1 mW optical input and a measurement microphone with 100 mW optical input. For the compact case, a 1 mm diameter, 1 micrometer thick, stress-free silicon diaphragm and 100% modulation efficiency give a predicted signal-to-noise ratio of 78 dB and acoustic overload pressure of 124 dB. The higher-power case lowers the modeled noise floor and increases dynamic range relative to the selected measurement microphone benchmark. These estimates rely on favorable assumptions and do not establish a substantial overall advantage in conventional microphone applications. Remote optical interrogation offers a separate motivation for harsh-environment sensing, but the temperature tolerance of the proposed sensing head remains unverified. The analysis identifies the design tradeoffs and measurements needed to test the predicted performance.

summaries.en: An analytical model of a diaphragm-integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer waveguide microphone links pressure-induced bending to photocurrent to separately assess mechanical sensitivity and optical detection limits, predicting 78 dB SNR and 124 dB acoustic overload for a compact MEMS design while noting that these estimates rely on favorable assumptions and that temperature tolerance remains unverified.
summaries.zh: 一个集成于振膜的Mach-Zehnder干涉仪波导麦克风的解析模型将压力引起的弯曲与光电流联系起来，从而分别评估机械灵敏度和光学探测极限，预测紧凑型MEMS设计的信噪比为78 dB、声学过载为124 dB，同时指出这些估计依赖有利假设且温度耐受性尚未验证。
summaries.ja: 振動板集積型マッハ・ツェンダー干渉計導波路マイクロホンの解析モデルは、圧力誘起のたわみを光電流に結び付けて機械感度と光検出限界を別々に評価し、コンパクトMEMS設計でSNR 78 dBと音響過負荷124 dBを予測する一方、これらの推定は有利な仮定に依存し温度耐性は未検証であると指摘する。

title: A Three-Axis Rydberg Atomic Receiver Model for Polarization-Based Direction-of-Arrival Sensing
abstract: This paper develops a three-axis Rydberg atomic receiver model for direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation of the radio frequency (RF) signal source. Three nominally orthogonal RF local oscillators (LOs), each assigned a distinct frequency offset, project the weak incident RF field into resolvable complex beat coefficients in the optical readout. A beat-vector observation is obtained by adopting a response calibration mechanism that maps the coefficients onto the three axes of the Cartesian coordinate system. For a known circularly polarised RF signal, this observation induces a direction-dependent Rydberg steering vector, enabling maximum-likelihood DoA estimation. The pro posed procedure translates the Rydberg beat-vector front end into a highly sensitive RF field DoA sensor. Simulation results show that trace-level beat extraction supports the proposed DoA sensing workflow and provides a basis for comparison with a traditional vector antenna (VA) benchmark.

summaries.en: This paper develops a three-axis Rydberg atomic receiver model that uses three frequency-offset local oscillators to extract complex beat coefficients and enable maximum-likelihood direction-of-arrival estimation for a circularly polarized RF signal.
summaries.zh: 本文建立了一种三轴里德堡原子接收机模型，利用三个具有不同频率偏移的本地振荡器提取复拍频系数，从而实现对圆极化射频信号的最大似然波达方向估计。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、異なる周波数オフセットを持つ3つの局部発振器を用いて複素ビート係数を抽出し、円偏波RF信号の最尤到来方向推定を可能にする三軸リュードベリ原子受信機モデルを開発した。
